scientific_question: Without assuming a shared parameter origin, is the accepted co-adapted late c_proj path an exact scaled right-orthogonal orbit, do dense-parent late layers deform more nearly within that orbit than early layers, and are the task-selected Givens supports reusable?

repair_scope.invalid_v1_premise: A shared model seed did not produce shared c_proj initialization because nn.Linear and MuonMatchedGivensLinear follow different construction and global reinitialization paths.
repair_scope.removed_measurement: All raw cross-run parameter displacement and path-alignment calculations are prohibited.
repair_scope.retained_measurements: Only within-run scaled-right-orbit recovery, normalized output-Gram deformation, support overlap, and temporal PCA are measured.
repair_scope.threshold_policy: Every surviving threshold is copied unchanged from the v1 plan that was frozen before any orbit measurement. No observed v1 value changed a v2 threshold.
repair_scope.scope: This analysis performs no fitting, model update, optimizer update, validation selection, or architecture change.

theory.procedural_invariant: The accepted hidden-side Givens plus scalar-decay implementation predicts W_next = s W Q within its own run, hence invariant normalized W W^T and singular shape.
theory.dense_parent_localization: Scaled-right-orbit recovery and normalized Gram drift are invariant to a fixed right-orthogonal change of coordinates and are computed between phases within each dense-parent layer. The early-versus-late comparison therefore does not require a shared gauge with the procedural run.
theory.support_transport: A fixed compact map needs stable task-selected edge support. Consecutive 99-update snapshot supports must clear both the frozen 10% retention threshold and twice the finite edge-universe random null.
theory.pca_caveat: Temporal PCA is descriptive and limited by the number and cadence of snapshots. It is not an intrinsic-dimension proof or a mapper-fit certificate.

outcomes.localized_and_reusable: Authorize only fixed-support compression analysis; no implementation or training.
outcomes.localized_but_moving: Authorize only phase-atlas compression analysis; no implementation or training.
outcomes.not_localized: Authorize only functional-metric path analysis to explain why adaptive task selection succeeds where static charts fail; no implementation or training.
outcomes.procedural_invariant_failure: Reject the scaled-right-orbit model and inspect implementation or snapshot semantics.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
